description: Ethernet MAC for eth_rmii_phy (100 Mbit/s): receives frames with the FCS checked and removed (`rx_good` with the last byte: CRC-32 right, no RX_ER, 64 to 1522 bytes) and sends them with preamble, padding to 60 bytes, FCS and the 96-bit inter-frame gap added. Bytes move one every fourth clock; a sender that falls behind gets its frame sent with an inverted FCS (every receiver drops it) and `tx_underrun`.

de.description: Ethernet-MAC für eth_rmii_phy (100 Mbit/s): empfängt Rahmen mit geprüfter und entfernter FCS (`rx_good` mit dem letzten Byte: CRC-32 richtig, kein RX_ER, 64 bis 1522 Bytes) und sendet sie mit Präambel, Auffüllung auf 60 Bytes, FCS und der 96-Bit-Pause zwischen Rahmen. Bytes laufen eines je vierten Takt; kommt der Sender nicht nach, geht sein Rahmen mit invertierter FCS hinaus (jeder Empfänger verwirft ihn) und `tx_underrun` wird gesetzt.
de.name: Ethernet-MAC

name: Ethernet MAC

parameters.description: Clocks of quiet after a frame's last byte is taken (48 = 96 bit times at 50 MHz, plus the PHY's last byte)
parameters.name: GAP_CLOCKS

ports.description: The PHY's 50 MHz reference clock (as eth_rmii_phy)
ports.name: clk

ports.description: Received byte: destination MAC to the payload's end, the FCS removed
ports.name: rx_data

ports.description: With rx_last: the frame is good (FCS, no RX_ER, length) — drop it otherwise
ports.name: rx_good

ports.description: Byte to send: destination MAC to the payload's end
ports.name: tx_data

ports.description: A byte is offered (keep it ready: the MAC doesn't wait)
ports.name: tx_valid

ports.description: High when tx_data is taken (with tx_valid)
ports.name: tx_ready

ports.description: The frame being sent had an underrun (it goes out with a bad FCS)
ports.name: tx_underrun
